slides.title: Gerund vs infinitive: stop, remember, try
slides.subtitle: Verbs that change meaning
goals: Know that some verbs change meaning with **-ing** or **to**.

head: Verb
+ -ing
+ to
rows: stop in order to: *I stopped **to buy** gas.*
memory of the past: *I remember **meeting** her.*
don't forget a duty: *Remember **to call** her.*
make an effort: *I tried **to open** it, but I couldn't.*

items.q: I stopped ___ a coffee on the way. (in order to)
I remember ___ to Disneyland as a child.
The door is stuck. I'm trying ___ it.
